name: The Rift
review:
An arcane alley on a 3x5 grid with 17 lines. Rift Spins come with assured wilds, and mystical wilds show up throughout the base game too.

Because Rift Spins always bring wilds, the bonus rarely feels empty. Low volatility, 815x cap, 96.3% RTP. A gentle, steady game with a moody look that never gets too dark. Good if you want a balance that lasts.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
